title: 第 七章 楚嫣然第 八章 学习炼丹
slug: 残鼎复元陆家修仙崛起路
content_zh:
陆行舟回到杂货店，与陆行夕打过招呼后，径直回到自己房间。
他解下腰间那鼓囊的布袋，取出溯源鼎。
将今日所买的火球符以及如同废丹的清灵散拿了出来，分别放入鼎内，随后又投入一颗灵石。
只见火球符毫无反应，而清灵散却化作了灵药。
陆行舟心中虽略有失望，但很快便想开了。
能将丹药还原，这已然是极为逆天之事，他理应知足。
陆行舟收拾好这一切，兴奋的从储物袋中掏出那枚玉简。
对于陆行舟这样初涉修仙界的新人而言，这份炼丹心得的价值简直不可估量。
他实在想不明白，那女子为何会将其拿出售卖。
在修仙界，修仙技艺如同功法一般，若非本族或是宗门之人，皆不会轻易外传。
而炼丹师相较于其他职业，更为稀少，尤其是高级炼丹师，无论走到何处，都备受尊崇。
要成为炼丹师，需耗费大量灵药用于练习。
而灵药生长周期漫长，这便意味着要投入海量灵石，到最后还未必能够成功，寻常人根本难以承受这般消耗。
像他们这种小家族的子弟，想要成为炼丹师，几乎是难如登天。
正因炼丹师稀缺，炼丹心得就愈发不会外传。
如今，有了这份炼丹心得，再加上溯原鼎，陆行舟便可以无消耗学习炼丹术。
在接下来的三个月里，陆行舟不是在修炼之中，就是在研究这份心得。
经过这段时间的研究，他感觉自己已将这份心得吃透了。
他打算正式开始学习炼丹。
由于一切都要靠自己摸索，他决定从最为基础的辟谷丹练起。

陆行舟将从那女子手中购得的炼丹炉仔细祭炼了一遍。
他打算先把炼丹所需的火焰先解决。
要知道，炼气修士炼丹，可不像筑基修士那般能够运用真火，他们必须借助外物来产生火焰炼丹。
常用的是火阳木，这种灵木燃烧时间持久，且火势稳定。
还有一种地火，不过地火通常只有大型仙城或是宗门才有。
炼制辟谷丹所需的材料，他想看看自家商铺是否有。
念及此，他离开房间，找到了陆行夕。
“三弟，你可真是勤快，除了吃饭就是修炼，怪不得如此年轻就达到炼气五层了。”陆行夕笑着说道。
“二哥，家族的情况你也清楚，我只能靠自己拼命修炼。”
“咱店铺里有火阳木和辟谷丹的材料吗？”陆行舟期待的问道。
陆行夕听闻，不禁疑惑地看向他。
“三弟，你该不会是打算学炼丹吧？听哥一句劝，有那些资源，你还是留着专心修炼。”
“炼丹就是个无底洞，到时候别丹没炼成，反倒拖累了你的修为。”陆行夕好心的劝道。
“二哥，我知道，只是偶然间得了一份初级炼丹师的心得，心里实在痒痒，就想试试。”
陆行舟故意这般说道，一来是为了打消陆行夕的顾虑。
二来也是提前给对方一个暗示，为自己日后炼出丹药找个说得过去的借口。
陆行夕见他如此坚持，深知不让他亲自尝试，他定然不会轻易放弃。
“三弟，火阳木店里倒是有，不过你得按正常价格购买，不然家族那边我不好交代。”
“至于辟谷丹的材料，我这儿没有，你去摆摊区看看，那边应该有不少。”
“那个……二哥，能不能借我几块灵石，过段时间一定还你。”

陆行舟面露尴尬之色。
此时他储物袋中仅剩下五块灵石，这还是他在修炼时极力节省下的。
content_en:
Lu Xingzhou returned to the grocery store, greeted Lu Xingxi, and then went straight back to his room.
He took off the bulging cloth bag at his waist and took out the Origin-Tracing Cauldron.
He took out the Fireball Talisman and the Qingling Powder that he bought today and put them into the cauldron respectively, and then put in a spiritual stone.
The Fireball Talisman showed no reaction, but the Qingling Powder turned into elixir.
Although Lu Xingzhou was a little disappointed, he quickly thought about it.
Being able to restore the elixir is already an extremely unnatural thing, and he should be satisfied.
Lu Xingzhou packed everything up and excitedly took out the jade slip from his storage bag.
For a newcomer like Lu Xingzhou, who is new to the world of immortality, the value of this alchemy experience is simply immeasurable.
He really couldn't understand why the woman would sell it.
In the world of cultivating immortals, the skills of cultivating immortals are like martial arts. Unless they are members of one's own clan or sect, they will not be easily passed on to others.
Compared with other professions, alchemists are rarer, especially senior alchemists, who are highly respected no matter where they go.
To become an alchemist, you need to spend a lot of elixirs for practice.
The growth cycle of elixirs is long, which means that a large amount of spiritual stones must be invested, and they may not be successful in the end. Ordinary people simply cannot bear such consumption.
For children from a small family like them, it is almost impossible to become an alchemist.
Precisely because there are so few alchemists, the knowledge of alchemy is less and less spread among the public.
Now, with this alchemy experience and the Suyuan Cauldron, Lu Xingzhou can learn alchemy without any consumption.
In the next three months, Lu Xingzhou was either practicing or studying this experience.
After this period of research, he felt that he had fully understood this experience.
He plans to officially start learning alchemy.
Since everything had to be explored by himself, he decided to start with the most basic Bigu Pill training.
Lu Xingzhou carefully refined the alchemy furnace he bought from the woman.
He planned to get rid of the flames needed for alchemy first.
You must know that Qi Refining monks are not able to use real fire like Foundation Establishment monks to make elixirs. They must use external objects to generate flames to make elixirs.
The most commonly used one is Huoyang wood, which has a long burning time and stable fire intensity.
There is also a kind of earth fire, but earth fire is usually only found in large fairy cities or sects.
He wanted to see if his store had the materials needed to refine the Bigu Pill.
Thinking of this, he left the room and found Lu Xingxi.
"Third brother, you are really diligent. Apart from eating, you practice cultivation. No wonder you have reached the fifth level of Qi Refining at such a young age." Lu Xingxi said with a smile.
"Second brother, you also know the situation of the family. I can only practice hard on my own."
"Do we have the ingredients for Huoyang Wood and Bigu Pill in our store?" Lu Xingzhou asked expectantly.
When Lu Xingxi heard this, he couldn't help but look at him in confusion.
"Third brother, are you planning to learn alchemy? Listen to my advice. If you have those resources, you should stay and concentrate on your cultivation."
"Alchemy is a bottomless pit. When the time comes, the other elixirs will not be refined, but it will drag down your cultivation." Lu Xingxi advised kindly.
"Second brother, I know. I just accidentally got the experience of a junior alchemist. I felt really itchy and wanted to try it."
Lu Xingzhou said this deliberately, firstly to dispel Lu Xingxi's worries.
Secondly, it is to give the other party a hint in advance and find a reasonable excuse for him to refine the elixir in the future.
Seeing his persistence, Lu Xingxi knew that he would not give up easily if he was not allowed to try it himself.
"Third brother, we do have it in the Huoyang Wood Store, but you have to buy it at the normal price, otherwise I won't be able to handle it for the family."
"As for the ingredients for Bigu Pills, I don't have them here. You can go to the stall area and have a look. There should be quite a few there."
"Um...Second brother, can you lend me some spiritual stones? I will return them to you in a while."
Lu Xingzhou looked embarrassed.
At this time, all he had left in his storage bag wasHe bought five spiritual stones, which he tried his best to save during his cultivation.
